clue.text: Appliance for cleansing gorgeous person?

blocks.note: surface reading: a machine that washes things
setter's reading: an attractive person is a dish in slang, so the machine is one that washes such a person

explanation.walkthrough: A good-looking person is slangily called a dish, so the kitchen machine sounds like something that bathes a beauty.
explanation.definitionFit: The kitchen machine that cleans plates and cutlery is named for washing dishes.

clue.text: Note failure to incorporate edging for sandal

indicators.note: to incorporate something is to take it in, so one piece is placed inside the others

blocks.note: F is a musical note
a lip is a rim or edge
a flop is a failure

explanation.surface: A shoemaker's mistake means a sandal ends up without its trim.
explanation.walkthrough: The edging goes between the note and the failure.
explanation.definitionFit: A flip-flop is a light open sandal held on by a thong between the toes.

clue.text: Female giant meets fellow male on board ship

blocks.note: an ogre is a male giant, a fellow of the female one
SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: A giantess falls in with a man aboard a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on board' can mean placed above, so the male giant sits on top of the ship.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogress is a female ogre, a monstrous giant of folklore.

clue.text: Performs deeds

blocks.note: first meaning: does a role on stage, verb
second meaning: things done, plural noun

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for taking a stage role and a plural noun for actions carried out.

clue.text: Fly exhibits crude courage

blocks.note: blue jokes are crude or smutty
bottle is British slang for nerve or courage

explanation.surface: An insect is credited with vulgar bravery.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang, having bottle means having nerve.
explanation.definitionFit: A bluebottle is a large buzzing blowfly with a metallic blue body.

clue.text: Occasional rotation aids crop

indicators.note: a rotation moves things round into new positions, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Farming advice: rotating fields helps a crop, if only now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: Sporadic means happening at irregular intervals, now and then rather than constantly.

clue.text: While cyclin'', I reach bomb test atoll

blocks.note: cycling is biking, and the dropped g is kept dropped
taken as written

explanation.surface: A cyclist arrives at a Pacific atoll used for nuclear tests.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe tells you the final G is dropped from the synonym too.
explanation.definitionFit: Bikini Atoll in the Marshall Islands was the site of American nuclear weapons trials after 1946.

clue.text: Male-only beetle?

blocks.note: first meaning: for men only, as in a party before a wedding
second meaning: a large horned insect

explanation.walkthrough: A stag party is the British name for a groom's night out with men only.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes an all-men gathering and also names a big beetle with antler-like jaws.

clue.text: Invalid and ailing, I go back to California

indicators.note: going back means reading the preceding pair of words in the opposite direction

blocks.note: ailing means unwell
taken as written
taken as written
Cal is a short form of California

explanation.surface: A sick person heads back to California.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Invalid' tempts as the sick person, but here it is the adjective meaning unsound.
explanation.definitionFit: An invalid argument is one that does not follow logically, so it is unreasoned.

clue.text: Portray suffering on television initially

indicators.note: initially points to the start of the word, so only its opening letter is used

blocks.note: pain is suffering
the first letter of television

explanation.surface: A drama on TV depicts someone in agony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' simply joins the pieces; only the word television is cut to its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To paint a person or scene is to depict it, in pigment or in words.

clue.text: Unlucky twist helps South Africa

indicators.note: a twist bends things out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
SA is the abbreviation for South Africa

explanation.surface: An unfortunate turn of events comes to South Africa's aid.
explanation.definitionFit: Hapless describes someone ill-fated, dogged by misfortune.

clue.text: Wear topless hoop as piece of jewellery

indicators.note: without a top means the first letter of the word is removed

blocks.note: wear without its first letter
a ring is a hoop

explanation.surface: Fashion advice: go topless and put on a hoop as your only jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: An earring is an ornament worn on the lobe, often a small hoop.

clue.text: A returning sailor who carries the world on his shoulders

definitions.text: who carries the world on his shoulders

indicators.note: something returning goes back the way it came, so the word is read backwards

blocks.note: taken as written
an old salt is a seasoned sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor home from the sea carries the weight of the world.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the Titan Atlas was condemned to hold up the heavens on his shoulders.

clue.text: Middle note of noisy number hits nirvana

blocks.note: middle C is the note at the centre of the piano
noisy means loud
nine is a number

explanation.surface: A loud song's central note strikes perfect bliss.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on cloud nine is an idiom for supreme happiness, a state of bliss like nirvana.

clue.text: Car takes king and I to floating barge to transport the shopping

definitions.note: the definition describes what the bag is for rather than naming it

indicators.note: something floating drifts loose and out of place, so the letters move around

blocks.note: taken as written
R stands for rex, Latin for king
taken as written
the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A car tows a king and me to a houseboat, groceries in hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A carrier bag is the British name for a plastic or paper shopping bag with handles.

clue.text: Fumes I take on cause fatigue

blocks.note: exhaust is the fumes from an engine
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Breathing in traffic fumes makes you tired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fumes' can look like a verb for being angry; it is the noun for engine gases.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhaustion is extreme tiredness, a state of fatigue.

clue.text: Oh, a pit coach trip disaster tests doctor''s code of ethics

indicators.note: a disaster throws everything into chaos, so the letters are jumbled

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged, ignoring the punctuation

explanation.surface: A coach outing that ends up in a pit puts a doctor's ethics to the test.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient oath attributed to Hippocrates binds physicians to ethical practice, such as doing no harm.

clue.text: Total absent-mindedness allows outside broadcast to show lion eating four

indicators.note: something eating takes another thing inside it

blocks.note: OB is the abbreviation for an outside broadcast
taken as written
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A TV crew films a lion devouring four victims, oblivious.
explanation.walkthrough: The Roman four goes inside the lion after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Oblivion is the state of being completely unaware or forgetful of everything.

clue.text: Agreeable French friend gets telegram

blocks.note: ami is French for friend
a cable is a telegram

explanation.surface: A friend in France receives a telegram.
explanation.definitionFit: Amicable means friendly and good-natured, as in an agreeable settlement.

clue.text: Loathsome salesman turns us evil

indicators.note: turning changes position, so the letters are reordered

blocks.note: a rep is a sales representative
the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A hateful salesman corrupts us.
explanation.definitionFit: Repulsive means disgusting, arousing strong distaste or loathing.

clue.text: Dad takes part in play to be let out of prison early

definitions.text: to be let out of prison early
definitions.note: a verb phrase defining a word that is also used as a verb

blocks.note: pa is an informal word for father
a role is an actor's part

explanation.surface: A father lands a stage part, hoping to win early release.
explanation.definitionFit: To parole a prisoner is to release them before their sentence ends, on conditions of good behaviour.

clue.text: Now I join European Union to bid French goodbye

blocks.note: AD, anno Domini, marks the present era
taken as written
EU is the abbreviation for European Union

explanation.surface: Britain says farewell to Europe in French as it joins up.
explanation.definitionFit: Adieu is the French word for farewell, used in English for a final parting.

clue.text: Running back inside, he purchased a cravat in the shopping mall

indicators.note: running back means travelling in the opposite direction, right to left
inside tells us the letters lie within the words that follow

blocks.note: the letters spanning the end of purchased, a, and the start of cravat

explanation.surface: A man buys a tie at the mall, then runs back.
explanation.definitionFit: An arcade is a covered walkway lined with shops, a kind of shopping mall.

clue.text: Look out! Some pointless poetry can go on eternally

indicators.note: points are compass directions, so being without them drops those letters

blocks.note: golfers shout this as a warning
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: A warning: aimless poetry can drag on and on.
explanation.walkthrough: S and E are compass points, removed from the end of the poetry word.
explanation.definitionFit: Forever means for all time, without end.

clue.text: Come to terms with appearance

blocks.note: first meaning: confront and accept, a verb
second meaning: the look of a person, a noun

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means confronting a situation; as a noun it is the front of the head, or outward look.

clue.text: Charm produces inclination to lose head

indicators.note: losing the head means the first letter is cut off

blocks.note: a penchant is a liking or inclination

explanation.surface: Charisma comes from a tendency to keep your head down.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain synonym as verbs: to captivate someone, as if casting a magic spell over them.

clue.text: The Spanish girl grows trees

blocks.note: el is Spanish for the
Ms is the title for a woman

explanation.surface: A Spanish girl is growing trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Elms are tall deciduous trees with serrated leaves.

clue.text: Instrument to add oxygen to part of organism

blocks.note: a cell is the basic unit of a living organism
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A lab instruction: supply oxygen to a part of a living thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'add oxygen to' tells you the oxygen symbol goes after the cell.
explanation.definitionFit: The cello is a large bowed stringed instrument played seated.

clue.text: Bony creature creates drama with lilo

indicators.note: to create is to make something new, so the letters are fashioned into another word

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged
the letters to be rearranged; a lilo is an inflatable mattress

explanation.surface: An animal makes a fuss over an airbed.
explanation.walkthrough: A lilo is a British brand name for an inflatable airbed used on the beach or in the pool.
explanation.definitionFit: The armadillo is an American mammal protected by a bony armoured shell.
